name: WildJailbreak
description: WildJailbreak is a large-scale open-source synthetic safety dataset consisting of 262K prompt-response pairs, including both vanilla and adversarial jailbreak queries, designed to improve and evaluate the safety and robustness of language models against jailbreak attacks.
reputation: A widely used open-source synthetic safety dataset for studying jailbreak robustness, especially in LLM safety research.
notes: Includes contrastive harmful and benign queries; enables balanced safety training and evaluation.
